descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 7500X3D Gaming Processor (6 Cores / 12 Threads / 96MB L3 3D V-Cache / Socket AM5 / Zen 4 Architecture / 4.0GHz Base & 4.5GHz Max Boost / PCIe 5.0 & DDR5 Support / 65W TDP / Heatsink Not Included / 1 Year Warranty)

Supercharge your gaming performance with the AMD Ryzen 5 7500X3D processor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty. Engineered on Zen 4 architecture for Socket AM5 motherboards, this 6-core, 12-thread desktop CPU packs a massive 96MB of L3 3D V-Cache to deliver low latency and high frame rates in esports and AAA titles. Operating at a 4.0 GHz base clock with boost speeds up to 4.5 GHz at a low 65W TDP, it supports DDR5 memory overclocking via AMD EXPO and PCIe 5.0 expansion. Please note: liquid cooling or a high-performance air cooler is recommended as a thermal solution is not included in the box.
